files.README.md:
# csharp-sql-ddl-postgresql

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories with their own SQL through ADO.NET and services, in C# for .NET 10. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch<T> per field: absent, null or a value.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/App/Database.cs              opens the database DATABASE_CONNECTION names
src/App/Db.cs                    one connection and its transaction, and how the repositories run SQL on it
src/App/IUnitOfWork.cs           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/App/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/App/Entities/                one entity per table
src/App/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/App/Services/                one service per table
tests/App.Tests/                 repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json               what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION="Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=app;Username=app;Password=app" dotnet test   # a real, disposable database: its tables are dropped and created again
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

using App;

namespace App.Tests;

/// <summary>The test database: the PostgreSQL database TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION names, created from the schema before every test.</summary>
internal static class TestDatabase
{
    // The tables are written for one kind of database: the tests cannot fall back to SQLite
    public static readonly string? Connection = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION");

    /// <summary>Removes every table, so the database starts empty.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] Drop =
    [
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "empties" CASCADE",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "audit"."entries" CASCADE",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "Order" CASCADE",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "kinds" CASCADE",
        "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "things" CASCADE",
        "DROP TYPE IF EXISTS "mood" CASCADE",
    ];

    /// <summary>Creates every table, in an order the database accepts.</summary>
    private static readonly string[] Create =
    [
        "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "audit"",
        "CREATE TYPE "mood" AS ENUM ('sad', 'ok', 'very happy')",
        "CREATE TABLE "things" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "token" uuid NOT NULL,
  "small" smallint NOT NULL,
  "num" integer,
  "big" bigint NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "r" real NOT NULL,
  "d" double precision,
  "flag" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  "born" date NOT NULL,
  "opens" time NOT NULL,
  "opens_tz" time with time zone NOT NULL,
  "at" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "at_tz" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "bin" bytea NOT NULL,
  "data" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "plain" json,
  "feeling" "mood" NOT NULL,
  "tags" text[] NOT NULL,
  "numbers" integer[],
  "ip" inet,
  "span" interval,
  "code" char(5) NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "changed" timestamptz DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "total" numeric(12,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (price * 2) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "kinds" (
  "code" varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  "day" date NOT NULL,
  "label" varchar(30),
  PRIMARY KEY ("code", "day")
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "Order" (
  "Id" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "user" varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  "group" integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "customerName" varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  "class" text,
  "metadata" text,
  "date" date,
  "time" time,
  "text" varchar(20),
  "list" text,
  "str" varchar(10),
  "int" integer,
  "dueDate" date NOT NULL,
  "closesAt" time,
  "createdAt" timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "kind_code" varchar(10),
  "kind_day" date,
  "thing_id" uuid,
  "parentId" bigint,
  PRIMARY KEY ("Id"),
  UNIQUE ("customerName"),
  CHECK ("group" >= 0),
  FOREIGN KEY ("thing_id") REFERENCES "things" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY ("parentId") REFERENCES "Order" ("Id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("kind_code", "kind_day") REFERENCES "kinds" ("code", "day")
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "audit"."entries" (
  "entry_no" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "orderId" bigint NOT NULL,
  "message" varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("entry_no"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("orderId") REFERENCES "Order" ("Id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)",
        "CREATE TABLE "empties" (
  "id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)",
    ];

    /// <summary>The test database, with every table dropped and created again; on one connection, as MySQL turns its foreign key checks off for the connection that asks.</summary>
    public static async Task<Db> OpenAsync()
    {
        if (Connection is null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The database tests need a disposable PostgreSQL database: set TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION (it is emptied)");
        var db = await Database.OpenAsync(Connection);
        foreach (var sql in Drop) await db.RunAsync(sql);
        foreach (var sql in Create) await db.RunAsync(sql);
        return db;
    }
}
